test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

LARGEST : ESTGLAR :: QUALITY : ITYLQUA :: QUICKLY : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Last three letter comes at first (in the same sequence), first three letter goes to last (in the same sequence) and fourth letter will remain at the same position.**

For, LARGEST : ESTGLAR</s
